items.source: Return an implementation of the TransactionOperations interface which executes a given TransactionCallback without an actual transaction.
items.translation: 返回一个实现 `TransactionOperations` 接口的实例，该实例在不进行实际事务的情况下执行给定的 TransactionCallback。

items.source: Uses of TransactionOperations in org.springframework.transaction.support
items.translation: 在 `org.springframework.transaction.support` 包中 `TransactionOperations` 的用法

items.source: Support classes for the org.springframework.transaction package.

Template class that simplifies programmatic transaction demarcation and
transaction exception handling.
items.translation: 简化程序化事务界定和事务异常处理的模板类。
